requirements.title: Automatic Light Activation
requirements.description: The system SHALL automatically activate lights when motion is detected in a room
acceptance_criteria: Light turns on within 200ms of motion detection

requirements.title: Adaptive Brightness Control
requirements.description: The system SHALL adjust light brightness based on ambient light levels measured by the lux sensor
acceptance_criteria: Brightness scales inversely with ambient lux
Minimum brightness 10%, maximum 100%

requirements.title: Motion Detection Response Time
requirements.description: The system SHALL respond to motion detection within 200ms maximum latency
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end latency from motion event to light activation <= 200ms in 99% of cases

requirements.title: 230V Installation Compatibility
requirements.description: The system SHALL be compatible with existing 230V residential wiring without requiring additional cabling
acceptance_criteria: No additional low-voltage wiring required for standard installation
Fits standard EU wall box (55mm diameter)

requirements.title: Standardized Error Diagnostics
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide a standardized error code interface for fault diagnosis
acceptance_criteria: Error codes follow IEC 62056 standard
At least 10 distinct error codes defined
Error codes accessible via local and remote interface

requirements.title: Electrical Compliance
requirements.description: The system SHALL comply with VDE 0100 and EN 60669 electrical installation standards
acceptance_criteria: Certified by accredited testing laboratory
CE marking obtained
Documentation includes compliance declaration

requirements.title: MQTT Connection Resilience
requirements.description: The system SHALL maintain a stable MQTT connection with automatic reconnection on network failure
acceptance_criteria: Reconnection within 30 seconds of network restore
No data loss during reconnection (queued messages sent)
Connection heartbeat interval configurable (default: 60s)

requirements.title: Bandwidth-Efficient Data Transmission
requirements.description: The system SHALL compress sensor data and transmit only on state changes to minimize bandwidth usage
acceptance_criteria: Average bandwidth usage < 1 KB/hour per sensor
State change threshold configurable per sensor type
Heartbeat message sent at least every 5 minutes even without state change

requirements.title: Over-the-Air Firmware Updates
requirements.description: The system SHALL support firmware updates over the air without physical device access
acceptance_criteria: Update package signed and verified before installation
Rollback to previous version on update failure
Update process does not interrupt local light control functionality

requirements.title: No Persistent Motion Data Storage
requirements.description: The system SHALL NOT persistently store motion detection data — only real-time processing is permitted
acceptance_criteria: Motion events processed in volatile memory only
No motion data written to non-volatile storage
Audit log confirms no persistent motion records

requirements.title: GDPR-Compliant Data Processing
requirements.description: The system SHALL process all personal data in compliance with GDPR — no cloud storage of presence data
acceptance_criteria: Presence data anonymized before cloud transmission
User consent mechanism for any data beyond local control
Data deletion on user request within 24 hours

requirements.title: Local Fallback Operation
requirements.description: The system SHALL maintain full local light control functionality when cloud connectivity is unavailable
acceptance_criteria: All motion-based and ambient-light-based controls work offline
Local schedules continue to execute without cloud
Cloud outage does not affect response time

requirements.title: Remote Diagnostics Access
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide remote access to system status, sensor readings, and error history for maintenance technicians
acceptance_criteria: System status dashboard accessible via cloud portal
Sensor readings available with < 5s latency
Error history retained for minimum 30 days

requirements.title: Modular Component Replacement
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow individual component replacement (sensor, actuator) without total system failure
acceptance_criteria: Hot-swap capable for sensor modules
System auto-detects replaced component and reconfigures
Replacement procedure documented and takes < 15 minutes

requirements.title: Integrated Self-Test
requirements.description: The system SHALL perform an integrated self-test of all components on startup and report results
acceptance_criteria: Self-test completes within 10 seconds of power-on
All sensors and actuators tested
Self-test results reported locally (LED indicator) and remotely (cloud status)
